Al_aggregate_scope: The baseline1000 plus excess on conservative amplified backgrounds is a diagnostic, not an exact operating mean or a rigorously complete time-envelope integral. The1000K baseline alone establishes the open-cavity vapor concern.

hydrogen_gas_return.scope: Neutral gas molecular-flow mean reference; effective global capture must actually exist. Multiply column by escape fraction / capture fraction. H2 does not condense at1000K.

dust_acceptance.scope: Poisson projected-area interception, one catastrophic-equivalent hit; a grain-damage fraction, not the probability an entire macropulse has any hit. Dust size/speed/energy-retention are assumptions; no source yield is inferred.

oxide_scope: Seven ideal-gas species Al,AlO,AlO2,Al2O,Al2O2,O,O2; alpha-Al2O3 activity1; congruent effusive O/Al flux3/2 and unit evaporation coefficients. No hydrogen/carbon reduction, radiation chemistry, sputtering, dissociation kinetics or defect enhancement. This is a thermal equilibrium reference, not irradiated service prediction.
